scope: LLM Serving 11 articles and On-device 2 articles

acceptance.article_unit: one article plus directly imported local components only when essential

findings.claim: GQA and MLA are central to the KV-byte argument but are never expanded or defined.
findings.correction: Define Grouped-Query Attention and Multi-head Latent Attention at first use or in the ConceptPrimer.

findings.claim: GEMM and roofline are used without a first-use gloss.
findings.correction: Add short matrix-multiplication and performance-model definitions.

findings.claim: RDMA, UCX, libfabric and NIXL are introduced without definitions.
findings.correction: Add a short transport-stack gloss at first use.

findings.claim: The quoted FlashAttention abstract assigns 2.4x to GPT-2 and a general 20x memory claim.
findings.evidence: The linked abstract reports 3x on GPT-2 and 2.4x on Long Range Arena; the 20x sentence is not in the abstract.
findings.correction: Use the actual abstract figures or rewrite as a correctly scoped paraphrase.

findings.evidence: The linked EAGLE abstract reports 2.7x-3.5x for LLaMA2-Chat 70B.
findings.correction: Use the linked paper's actual figure or cite the source that reports 2.13x-3.06x.

findings.claim: The file tree exposes block-pool and speculative-decoding files but the sidebar receives only sharedCodeRefs, leaving many visible nodes disabled.
findings.correction: Merge the relevant CodeRef maps or restrict the tree to wired files.
Expand Automatic Prefix Caching at first use.

findings.claim: The allocation-layout ASCII diagram is attributed to vendored source lines 289-321.
findings.evidence: The diagram is at kv_cache_manager.py lines 250-271; lines 289-321 contain prose and executable allocation code.
findings.correction: Point the article and CodeRef to lines 250-271, or 250-282 including abbreviations.

findings.evidence: Vendored scheduler.py computes num_tokens_with_spec + num_output_placeholders - num_computed_tokens.
findings.correction: Add the placeholder term or explicitly scope the simplified equation to synchronous scheduling.

findings.claim: The source link for SpecDecodeBaseProposer constructor logic exists only in an unrendered Overview component.
findings.correction: Add a reachable CodeViewButton in DraftVerify or EagleMtp, or remove the superseded dead component and re-home the link.

findings.claim: EAGLE3 is used before its later definition.
findings.correction: Define the EAGLE versus EAGLE3 distinction at first use.

findings.evidence: The adjacent release visualization treats 240s as startup through engine-alive and places readiness warmup in a later gate.
findings.correction: Scope 240s to the startup lower bound or include the additional readiness duration.

findings.claim: DRA is said to have become stable in Kubernetes 1.35.
findings.evidence: DRA core graduated to GA/stable in 1.34; 1.35 locks the feature gate on.
findings.correction: Attribute stable graduation to 1.34 and optionally explain the 1.35 lock-on change.

findings.claim: KV, preemption and canary are first used without definitions.
findings.correction: Add inline glosses or ConceptPrimer entries.

findings.claim: The OpenTelemetry GenAI attributes link is a legacy location.
findings.correction: Optionally update to the current semantic-conventions-genai canonical repository.

findings.claim: KV is used as a load-bearing term without expanding Key-Value cache.
findings.correction: Add a first-use KV cache gloss.

findings.claim: Several underbraced formula outputs and overhead terms are missing from adjacent FormulaNote symbol tables.
findings.correction: Add symbol rows for T_token, T_launch/T_sync, L_MTP and S.

findings.claim: TOPS and NPU are not expanded at first use.
findings.correction: Expand Tera Operations Per Second and Neural Processing Unit.
Expand Out Of Memory or use Korean wording.
